_meta: Field lists are reconstructed from every Firestore read/write site found across functions/*.js and lib/screens/*.dart. This is not a schema export from Firebase console (no admin access was used); fields that exist in the live database but are never referenced in code would not appear here, and this repository contains no firestore.rules or storage.rules file, so access-control cannot be documented from code.

collections.name: Users
referenced_by: Users doc id == Firebase Auth uid

collections.name: Jobs
referenced_by: MockInterviews (no JobID - mock interviews are specialty-based, not job-based)

collections.name: MockInterviews
collections.notes: No PDF/ReportURL field - mock interview reports are rendered directly from this document in-app.

collections.name: AdminOTPs
collections.notes: Written directly by the Flutter client (login.dart) after the sendAdminOtp/sendSignupOtp/sendPasswordResetOtp Cloud Function confirms the email was sent.

collections.name: Other collections referenced only in deleteUserAccount's cascade (schema not otherwise visible in this repo)
collections.notes: These collection names appear only as delete-by-query targets in functions/index.js deleteUserAccount / onJobDeleted; no code in this repository was found that writes to them, so their live schema (or whether they are still in active use) cannot be confirmed from this codebase alone.
